scope: Resource and import preflight only; no model inference or scoring
resource_probe: HTTP Range ZIP directory and JSON metadata only; never deserialize weights, execute archive code or extract paths
environment: New overlay venv; existing nli-inference-env site-packages read-only via explicit .pth. Install pinned HanLP and only missing small dependencies with --no-deps; no CUDA/torch replacement. Record package/import origins and pip check. This is a layered preflight, not a standalone reproducible environment.
stop: Preserve failed HTTP ranges/imports; no unrestricted fallback download, unsafe pickle loading, dependency mutation of earlier environments, or silent weight-license assumption. Import success is not model-load success.
mapping_boundary: Preserve predicate/frame/span outputs. Do not map ARG0/ARG1 universally to actor/object, or synthesize condition, obligation or fact fields. Need separate frozen mapping and evaluation after actual model configuration is known.
